classification.difficultyReason: Read the shaded limits from each graph and account for curves lying to the left of the y-axis when evaluating definite integrals.

content.prompt: Find the area of each shaded region below by evaluating the appropriate integral.

spec.description: Descending straight line with a triangular shaded region to the left of the y-axis between y=1 and y=4. Source blue shading uses the house light blue.
spec.mathematics: x=1-y; vertices of the shaded triangle are (0,1), (0,4) and (-3,4).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the requested shaded region are visible.

answer.worked:
The region lies to the left of the $y$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}A&=-\int_1^4(1-y)\,dy\\A&=-\left[y-\frac{y^2}{2}\right]_1^4\\A&=-\left[(4-8)-\left(1-\frac12\right)\right]\\A&=\frac92\text{ u}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right-opening parabola with its shaded lobe between the curve and the y-axis. Both y-intercepts and the x-intercept are labelled.
spec.mathematics: x=(y-3)^2-1=y^2-6y+8; y-intercepts 2 and 4; x-intercept 8; shaded interval 2≤y≤4.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and shading are visible.

answer.worked:
Between $y=2$ and $y=4$, the curve lies to the left of the $y$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}A&=-\int_2^4(y^2-6y+8)\,dy\\A&=-\left[\frac{y^3}{3}-3y^2+8y\right]_2^4\\A&=-\left[\left(\frac{64}{3}-48+32\right)-\left(\frac83-12+16\right)\right]\\A&=-\left(\frac{16}{3}-\frac{20}{3}\right)\\A&=\frac43\text{ u}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Increasing cubic-shaped curve through the origin with a shaded region to the left of the y-axis between the labelled negative y-values.
spec.mathematics: x=∛y, equivalently y=x^3; shaded interval -8≤y≤-1 with endpoints on the curve (-2,-8) and (-1,-1).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and shading are visible.

answer.worked:
The region lies to the left of the $y$-axis. Using real cube roots:
$$\begin{align*}A&=-\int_{-8}^{-1}\sqrt[3]{y}\,dy\\A&=-\left[\frac34\left(\sqrt[3]{y}\right)^4\right]_{-8}^{-1}\\A&=-\frac34\left[(-1)^4-(-2)^4\right]\\A&=-\frac34(1-16)\\A&=\frac{45}{4}\text{ u}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Left-opening parabola with the upper region bounded by the curve, y-axis and horizontal line y=3 shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and shading are visible.

answer.worked:
The region lies to the left of the $y$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}A&=-\int_0^3(-y^2)\,dy\\A&=\left[\frac{y^3}{3}\right]_0^3\\A&=\frac{27}{3}-0\\A&=9\text{ u}^2\end{align*}$$
